data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'ruti', meaning 'contentment'. It is also believed to be derived from the word 'rutu', meaning 'season' or 'rut', meaning 'wheel'. The name signifies the turning of the wheel of life, symbolizing the constant flow of life and the idea of finding contentment in the present moment. The name Rutika carries the meaning “Contentment” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rutika usually hope their child will grow to embody contentment and live with faith, good character and purpose.
